notes: prisma: the generated client is SHARED via the node_modules symlink. Don't run `prisma generate` mid-work across parallel worktrees; verify with jest, and do generate+tsc atomically once at the end.
jest: always run it from INSIDE this worktree (cd first), or the cli/package.json haste collision silently runs the wrong tests.
npm: never `npm install` / `npm ci` inside a worktree — npm replaces the node_modules symlink with a full standalone tree. Install in the main checkout only.
